name: login-splash
description: Login-screen splash: a full-viewport panel with a background picture and a centred column of headings, copy, images and a button, sized for the iframe the product's login page draws (it hides the top 125px and is 100vh + 125px tall). Live: the 20 /login-splash-*/ pages (rules ported from the live theme's .login-splash sheet). Renders without the site header and footer on the login-splash template.

background.description: Background picture URL. Drawn at its own size from the top-left corner and scaled up only to cover the panel, as live does.

background_width.description: Background picture's intrinsic width in px (written on the ). 0 omits it.

background_height.description: Background picture's intrinsic height in px. 0 omits it.

background_color.description: Panel colour under the picture (hex), seen only until the picture loads.

column.description: Width of the centred column from 768px up, in twelfths of the container: 8 (The Latest pages) or 6 (Panda Pit Stop / Power Hour pages). Below 768px the column is full width.

items.description: Column content, top to bottom. Each item has a type: space (size: px of empty space), image (image, alt, width, height; wide: true lets it grow to 110% of the column like live's header art), heading (text; tag: h1 or h2), text (text; bold: true), button (label, url; new_tab: true opens a new tab), cta (image, alt, url: an image link centred in the column, e.g. a HubSpot CTA).
